archetypes.name: dyn-implement-routing
archetypes.rationale: Review lazy-reference routing predicates and Phase A re-entry semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed /implement prompt routing. Verify that force-mode and architectural-guidelines present-plus-ok references are loaded only on their intended predicates, and that absent, invalid, diff-failed, and hard-failure branches still route exactly as before. Pay special attention to conflict-resolution re-entry before Step 8 ship retries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-harness-pins
archetypes.rationale: Review whether updated shell harness pins match relocated prose without overfitting.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the edited regression harnesses and their sibling docs. Check that force grammar assertions moved to force-mode.md, present-plus-ok assertions moved to architectural-guidelines-present.md, and SKILL.md assertions still cover only inline routing. Look for fragile or malformed grep literals in the changed shell scripts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
